name: airgenome
title: 🧬 airgenome — architecture tree
summary: OS genome scanner — every host's live vitals projected onto a 6-axis resource hexagon (cpu · mem · io · net · gpu · fs), serialized as a 60-byte genome, accumulated in a ring buffer, labeled for anomalies, and forecast 1 h ahead (Holt α/β). Self-hosted in hexa-lang and shipped as a native macOS menubar daemon (⌃S launcher). The tick loop converges as a Banach 1/3 contraction toward a stable resource fixed point — each tick maps the current resource state toward a stable fixed point at contraction factor 1/3, so the adaptive throttle settles deterministically rather than oscillating.
note: This JSON tree is the architecture SSOT (update-in-place, NOT append-only). Human viewer = ARCHITECTURE.html via `python3 serve.py` (http; browsers block file:// fetch). History/decisions → CHANGELOG.md; governance → CLAUDE.md / README.md. Migrated 2026-06-18 from ARCHITECTURE.md (prose) + the scattered domain snapshot/log docs (AIRGENOME.md/.log.md · DESIGN.md/.log.md · HUSH.md/.log.md · EDID.md · domains/C-PORT.md/.log.md) + DOMAINS.tape (the retired `harness domain` roster) into this single tree SSOT (hexa-codex #161 / anima pattern). Every retired doc's substance is folded into node summary/note fields below; the full append-only DESIGN decision ledger + HUSH/C-PORT step logs remain recoverable via `git log` of the deleted files.

meta.verify: L0 invariant for every module = file present ∧ parse OK ∧ self-test PASS (3-way gate). `hexa verify` runs the parse + self-test gate (wired as the harness verify check). Protected branches: main, master (harness pre-push / branch-protection in the hardcore profile).
meta.migrated_from: ARCHITECTURE.md (prose) + domain snapshot/log .md docs + DOMAINS.tape → ARCHITECTURE.json tree SSOT + ARCHITECTURE.html viewer (c4 standard), 2026-06-18; the `harness domain` feature is retired upstream so DOMAINS.tape (its roster) is gone too.

children.name: Tick pipeline — probe → dispatch → harvest → label → forecast
children.summary: Each tick runs a five-stage pipeline over the 6-axis hexagon. Input = live host vitals. Processing = hexagon encode → ring accumulate → rule label → Holt smoothing. Output = infra_state.json (state) + labeled_anomaly.jsonl (anomalies) + forecast.jsonl (1 h-ahead prediction). The AdaptiveThrottle in the core contracts the tick interval toward its fixed point (Banach 1/3) based on observed load.

children.name: 1. probe
children.summary: sample Mac vitals → nexus/shared/infra_state.json. (Cross-host probing of remote Ubuntu/Hetzner was scoped out — airgenome runs mac-local only since PR #89, 2026-05-22.)

children.name: 2. dispatch
children.summary: pick the best host per workload (AG6 Mac-protect, AG7 fallback) → dispatch state.

children.name: 3. harvest
children.summary: top-N processes → 60-byte hexagon per process → forge/*.ring (ring buffer) → sigdiff deltas.

children.name: 4. label
children.summary: match accumulator rules → forge/labeled_anomaly.jsonl.

children.name: 5. forecast
children.summary: Holt double-exponential (α / β) smoothing → 1 h-ahead → forge/forecast.jsonl. Cited delivery grade: Holt MAE 0% held-out.

children.name: DESIGN — design rules + decision ledger
children.summary: airgenome's live design rules (formerly @D governance blocks in the retired project.tape; identity + governance now consolidated into CLAUDE.md / README.md as the markdown governance SSOT). Append-only decision audit trail — one decision per gate, never batched, each entry's rationale ≥ 3 bullets.
children.note: Was DESIGN.md (pointer) + DESIGN.log.md (decision ledger, 5 decisions, recoverable via git log). Decisions preserved: (1) snippet auto-input via direct CGEventKeyboardSetUnicodeString typing over clipboard paste — content never lands on the system clipboard; (2) register @D g_post_impl_reinstall governance entry — every artifact-affecting impl ends with `hx install airgenome`; docs-only edits exempt; (3) chase the external SIGKILL matcher before any install fallback — identify the matcher first, do NOT shortcut to make install; (4) bypass shim via fresh-copy + `exec -a hexa` (matcher isolated to an exact-path allowlist of hexa binaries); (5) ABORT decision-4's hand-rolled bypass — rely on anima §169 RATE-LIMIT-GOVERNANCE-DESIGN auto-cycle: the matcher is AppleSystemPolicy (ASP) kernel enforcement matching by binary name, and anima rotates the shim's exec target on each ASP ban, so a hand-rolled copy+exec shim would race anima's writes for zero added robustness.

children.name: HUSH — macOS 부하 완화 (system load mitigation)
children.summary: Reduces CPU/battery/fan load of system daemons & background services. Auto-applied by `airgenome init` (hush step runs idempotently) or standalone `airgenome hush` (one sudo prompt; die on refusal). Implementation = bin/airgenome cmd_hush(). Env toggles: AIRGENOME_NO_HUSH · AIRGENOME_HUSH_NOSUDO.
children.note: Was HUSH.md (state) + HUSH.log.md (step log, recoverable via git log). Applied mitigations: XProtect definition updates OFF (ConfigDataInstall=0 · CriticalUpdateInstall=0); Spotlight global indexing OFF (mdutil -a -i off → FSSearchOnly, search UI falls back to filename); mds/mds_stores/mdworker_shared auto-quit after Spotlight OFF; ~/.hexa-cache indexing blocked (.metadata_never_index flag · xattr -cr); ~/Downloads quarantine xattr stripped; Mullvad split-tunnel OFF (ESF subscriber stays asleep); macOS auto-update OFF (AutomaticDownload=false · AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates=false · AutoInstallProductKeys=[]) → softwareupdated 21%→0%. ROOT-CAUSE chain: claude/hexa fork·exec storm → Mullvad eslogger (ESF subscriber) → XprotectService (yara, was ~70%) + syspolicyd (code-sign verify). The real load is the user's own work (claude × 6 sessions running hexa run → clang fork storm), not the security daemons (those are the effect). A hexa-lang fix (content-addressed cache key hexa_run.<sha16>_<ver>) cut a 3-run from 380→100ms and dropped load avg 82.81→4.46 (-95%). SIP-protected daemons (xprotectd, the XProtect.daemon.scan set) need Recovery → csrutil disable first; the bootout/disable full-set is staged but pending. Open follow-ons: replayd permanent disable when screen-recording unused; LaunchAgent cleanup (com.anima.*); 24h re-observation for Spotlight/XProtect auto-reactivation.

children.name: EDID — DisplayLink USB monitor resolution options
children.summary: @goal: expose macOS-hidden HiDPI scale + 1:1 native modes for a LG UltraFine 4K portrait monitor connected via DisplayLink USB, selectable in System Settings, via an EDID override. Applied by `airgenome init` (cmd_display_override after cmd_hush, one sudo prompt) or standalone `airgenome display-override` (idempotent — airgenome-managed marker → skip).
children.note: Was EDID.md (no log). Target: LG UltraFine 4K (Vendor 0x1e6d, Product 0x5cbb, 2 units same product code → single override covers both; panel native 2160×3840; found via CGGetActiveDisplayList Swift probe since ioreg doesn't expose the DisplayLink virtual display). Override file: /Library/Displays/Contents/Resources/Overrides/DisplayVendorID-1e6d/DisplayProductID-5cbb (root:wheel 644, 750 bytes, XML plist, sudo to write). Exposes 7 modes (1080×1920 2×, 960×1707 2×, 864×1536 2×, 810×1440 2×, 2160×3840 1:1, 1620×2880 1:1, 1080×1920 1:1). Apply needs a reboot (EDID cache read once at boot, no hot-reload), then System Settings → Displays → ⌥-click Resolution. Limits: cannot reduce DisplayLink CPU pump (USB framebuffer forced to panel-native by firmware — override only adds UI-scale modes); panel-native itself cannot be overridden on DisplayLink. Rollback: rm the override file + reboot. Implementation: bin/airgenome cmd_display_override (66 lines, python3 plistlib 16-byte big-endian entries per scaled resolution). DRM note: with DisplayLink attached, Safari blocks FairPlay-protected video full-screen (no HDCP path, KB 830301); Chrome/Edge with HW accel OFF plays at 720p (manual fix in README § DRM video + DisplayLink).
